notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness. There are at least four colors among permanents you control.
description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.
